longmemeval/run_baseline.py.context_log: per-item JSONL of the EXACT context blocks the reader saw + the hypothesis. Required because U is defined against that arm's own context and run_baseline's notes_examples field keeps only 3 entries (NEW_BLOCKER_9).
longmemeval/run_baseline.py.arm_label: derived from (compressor, evidence_mode) and written into the report AND every context record, so the arm is recoverable from the artifact rather than from shell history.
longmemeval/run_baseline.py.MoM_label_fix: session_id and text now use the compressor's `label` property. With self-notes the old hardcoded 'MoM-NOTES' / 'MoM NOTES:' strings were factually wrong MODEL INPUT, because Evidence.as_block renders session= into the prompt. mom_notes keeps label='MoM' so its prompt is byte-identical.

longmemeval/compressor.py.blocker_4_SelfNotesCompressor: shares the reader's ALREADY-LOADED model/tokenizer (no second from_pretrained, so 'same model' is a fact not a claim); generates from the same post-token-budget evidence list; greedy (do_sample=False, num_beams=1) matching the reader; max_new_tokens=128.
longmemeval/compressor.py.notes_cache: {question_id, notes, n_evidence, evidence_round_ids, source, max_new_tokens} JSONL. Generate ONCE, then BOTH notes arms read the same strings -- 'same notes text' is part of the frozen single variable, and regenerating per arm would leak decoder nondeterminism into the contrast.
longmemeval/compressor.py.notes_cache_readonly: a cache MISS raises instead of silently regenerating.
longmemeval/compressor.py.instruction_shared_verbatim: _NOTES_INSTRUCTION is byte-identical to the literal MoMNotesCompressor previously inlined, and both classes now use it, so the notes PROMPT does not become a second uncontrolled variable when the generator changes.
longmemeval/compressor.py.label_property: added to the Compressor ABC, defaulting to 'MoM'.

code_changes.longmemeval/faithfulness.py: NEW. The U scorer. numpy-free by design (three numpy versions across the five nodes make same-seed multinomial node-dependent), paired bootstrap with the pre-registered seed=42 / 10,000 resamples, reports disc_U and the K2 disc_U <= 0.0872 evaluability precondition alongside Delta_U.

auditability.per_item_records_not_just_an_aggregate: score_arm emits one record per item (question_id, question_type, arm, is_abstention, in_U_denominator, hypothesis, n_context_blocks, n_context_tokens, n_claims, n_unsupported_claims, unsupported) and one record per CLAIM (claim text, is_refusal, n_salient, ungrounded_salient, supported, rule).
auditability.aggregate_is_recomputable_from_the_trail: asserted in the tests: item['unsupported'] == any(not c['supported'] for c in item['claims']).
auditability.the_CLI_cannot_emit_an_aggregate_without: if --per_item_out is not given, the per-item records are inlined into the output JSON.
auditability.determinism: no model, no sampling, sorted iteration, stdlib RNG. Two calls to paired_bootstrap_gap on the same pairs are equal (tested).

TOOLING_FINDING_the_recommended_repair_t.what: check_stale_absence_claims.py matches an absence phrase next to a filename ANYWHERE in a STATUS.json. A superseding key that QUOTES the stale sentence verbatim -- the natural way to write such a record -- therefore trips the checker itself.
TOOLING_FINDING_the_recommended_repair_t.measured: The first draft of blocker_1_premise_STALE_20260816 quoted the sentinel and produced 2 ABSENCE-regex hits IN ISOLATION; after paraphrasing (identify the stale claim BY LOCATION -- the two key paths -- instead of reproducing its text) it produces 0. Both new keys now measure CLEAN in isolation.
TOOLING_FINDING_the_recommended_repair_t.consequence_if_unnoticed: B08's row would have stayed red forever, even after the original sentinels were repaired, and the redness would have been caused by the repair. Whoever fixes the other seven proposals needs either paraphrasing keys or a suppression mechanism in the checker.
TOOLING_FINDING_the_recommended_repair_t.how_it_was_found: by importing the checker's own ABSENCE regex and running it over the new key alone, rather than trusting that a superseding key is by construction clean.
